purpose: Prevent the legacy three-training-seed analyzer from being used for the user-directed two-training-seed fixed-setting decision, while preserving the frozen implementation boundary during the active Phase-1 runtime.

reasons: It requires training seeds 42, 43, and 44 exactly.
Its hierarchical bootstrap samples three seed slots rather than the frozen two seed slots.
Its pass/fail checks implement the superseded original three-seed gate.
It does not produce the required unfiltered and fixed-30-problem-filtered four-gate decision artifact.
legacy_analyzer_assessment.prohibited_use: Do not pass only seeds 42 and 43 to the legacy analyzer and do not reinterpret its output as the amended final gate.

implementation_release_conditions: The Phase-1 controller has been deliberately stopped, not merely paused while an evaluation is finalizing.
Seed-43 I0 and I8 training contracts and full-benchmark postverification artifacts are independently verified.
All four I0/I8 by seed-42/43 record files and verification-artifact hashes are available and immutable.
The frozen scope amendment, execution spec, exclusion source, and bound reference-code hashes still match this audit.
required_next_action_after_release: Implement a dedicated two-seed analyzer and tests that satisfy every validation, metric, bootstrap, gate, output, and claim-policy requirement in the frozen execution spec before reading the numerical gate output.
